Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E●CHIEF COMPLAINTS:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 35 year old female,resident of miryalguda,worker in steel shop,came\u0026nbsp; with chief complaints of\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E•Fever since 12 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E•Shortness of breath since 10 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E•Cough since 8 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E●HISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS:-\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe was apparently asymptomatic 12 days back,and then she developed fever which was insidious in onset,continuous,high grade and not associated with chills and rigors,for which she went near local RMP and took some medications and temperature decreased.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAnd then she developed breathlessness 10 days back,which was insidious in onset,gradually progressive,SOB is of grade 1 i.e when climbing stairs.SOB aggravated on\u0026nbsp; exposure to dust and cool air,seasonal variation is present.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of cough since 8days,which is productive,mucopurulent,non foul smelling, and subsided on medication.Cough aggravated on lying in supine position and relieved gradually on sleeping to one side.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o tightness in chest,No H\/0 palpitations ,sweatings,syncopal attacks,b\/l pedal edema.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo h\/o wheeze,hemoptysis,decrease urinary output,burning micturition,weight loss\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E●PAST HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe is a known case of Asthma since 6years, which was aggravated on dusting the house for which she used inhaler(ASTHALIN),2-3 times in a month.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe develops SOB on climbing 20 steps upstairs i.e grade 1 SOB.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe is not a known case of Diabetes mellitus,Hypertension,Tuberculosis,Epilepsy.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E●PERSONAL
